## 1. Data preparation  

| Step | Action | Details |

| Load training data | `load_dataset` | `{"dataset_name":"CWRU", "split":"train"}` |

| Load ground‑truth RUL (remaining cycles at failure) | `load_ground_truth` | `{"dataset_name":"CWRU", "file":"RUL_CWRU.txt"}` |

The CWRU data set contains 12 test bearings (units 1‑12). Each unit is a time‑series of vibration amplitudes from the drive‑end (DE) and fan‑end (FE) sensors, sampled every 0.1 s. The ground‑truth file gives the true number of cycles remaining at the moment each test was stopped (i.e., the true RUL).
